description: This PHP source file defines the SavePayGradeController class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for handling the save operation of PayGrade entities in the admin plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and prepares a Vue component based on request attributes, either for editing or adding a pay grade.

classes.name: SavePayGradeController
classes.description: Controller responsible for preparing the Vue component for adding or editing a pay grade in the OrangeHRM admin plugin.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component based on whether an existing pay grade ID is provided; sets the component for the view.
